info.name: Slink Uploader
info.summary: Upload images to a Slink image host from the Files context menu
info.description: Adds "Upload to Slink" actions to the file context menu for images. The selected image is sent to a configured Slink API endpoint on your own server. The returned share URL is copied to the clipboard and stored as an updatable comment on the file (one comment per context-menu entry). Context-menu entries (display name and URL parameters appended to the share URL, e.g. width limits) are configurable under Administration settings -> Slink Uploader.
info.author: beautiful-orca
